posts.name: lin
posts.cooked:
Login to oppe Vm
you can see list of question available ‘ls /opt/se2001’
you have to create directory in se2001 folder ‘cd ~/se2001’
then ‘mkdir nppe2.1.1.{1…5}’
then ‘cd nppe2.1.1.1’
then ‘synchro show’
